reviews.title: $164.99 for what?  What a rip.
reviews.text:
Windy talks a big game about wind analysis, yet it cant even model a simple wind rose unless you are in a specific location.  And even then you gamble on what model you want to choose.  Epic fail.

Save your money.  The app is better at collecting annual fees.

reviews.title: Deceptive pricing
reviews.text:
This app has the most purposefully deceptive pricing I’ve ever seen. 

Don’t give them a dime.

reviews.title: Good except
reviews.text: Good weather but the predatory dark patterns used to upsell in this app are not ignorable. Things like lying that there is a promotional price which only last x minutes but pops up every single time you open the app, also the “cancel/refuse” offer button is red and in the opposite place from usual. This developer definitely read a book on design dark patterns and said “I should implement every single one I can”

reviews.title: tides.
reviews.text: tides are wrong for my area.

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: This app is terrible.  Definitely not worth the money.

reviews.title: NO WIND speed or WIND on windy!!?! Dumb! Why?
reviews.text: It is very windy outside. Wind should be listed and it’s NOT!! Had to look at it multiple times just to make sure I wasn’t going crazy. Deleting. Windy without winds listed!

reviews.title: Way less accurate than Apple weather
reviews.text: This was my go to app. I’m not sure what they changed but it has been off for a while now when it used to be spot on. My Apple app has been way more accurate. I won’t be renewing it at this point.

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text:
Completely useless on my phone. EVERY click is just trying to get you to subscribe paragraph on my desktop. I can see a map… On my phone. It is a useless nightmare.

I don’t exaggerate, literally a useless nightmare.

If I hadn’t seen a function on the desktop I would think it was garbage.

reviews.title: Relentless Offers sent on phone - STOP!!!
reviews.text: Unrelenting offers & discounts sent on the app / phone.  No clear instructions on how to turn these off

reviews.title: Amazing app deceptive sales
reviews.text: This app looks like it could be amazing. However, the advertisement that you click to get to it first says there is an option for monthly payment. There is not. There is only a yearly payment. Also, they advertise it as a fishing app, which is what I wanted. However, once you get into it, you have to pay an additional $50 a year to get the fishing portion of the app. That's a total of $200 a year with no other options. I wish they would be upfront at the beginning so I did not have to waste my time downloading. Again, it looks like it could be amazing, but not everybody can spend $200 a year to try out an app.

reviews.title: Unusable on free plan
reviews.text: Too many confusingly worded prompts to upgrade to pro like “refuse the upgrade” with the color of the yes/no swapped around to try to mentally trick you into pressing the wrong one (Dark Pattern) Happens so frequently that the app is unable in free mode. I can’t even navigate the app for 2 minutes without 4 full screen overlays begging me to upgrade. Happened within the first few minutes of use which is against apples tos. Just use a website that has the app embedded.

reviews.title: Typical pop ups
reviews.text: Does what I want, but super annoying pop ups. Every single time I use the app it asks if I want to upgrade. Then I have to stop what I’m doing and select “no.”  Then it pops up with “are you sure you want to decline?” It is so annoying. I’ve been using other applications that are less absurd because of how this one operates. Everyone hates the subscription model. It is so dumb. The constant pop ups to try and make you subscribe are such a turn off. I’d consider a one time purchase, but the move to every single app being a subscription is so cringe. I know they’ll say, “app development costs money.” BS, but I guess people fall for that.

reviews.title: Low Accuracy is NOT EVEN CLOSE Accurate
reviews.text: I thought I loved Wendy until today. I figured out when they say low accuracy mode what they really mean is is they giving you bad information that you really do need so when I checked tides today it showed a low tide of close to 3 feet at 8 AM but the truth was it was only a foot at 8 AM.  I see them not being very accurate but then to just basically give you horribly bad information that makes it dangerous. I do not understand.

reviews.title: Unbelievable and not in the good way
reviews.text: This app is deceiving. I signed up for it because everything that was being presented on Facebook showed them to be a fishing app. I signed up for the app which costs approximately $50 per year and downloaded it. During setup it has you tell them all about how you fish and what you’re fishing for and makes you think that you are getting a fishing app however, as soon as you login, they hit you for another $65 per year to access the fishing portion of the app.  This is not a fishing app primarily, it is a very expensive weather app with a costly fishing add-on.

reviews.title: Works but Nagware warning
reviews.text: Far too frequent “last chance” sales offers kneecap this otherwise useful app

reviews.title: Bad
reviews.text: Only 5 day weather

reviews.title: Rubbish
reviews.text: I downloaded the app paid the subscription for the fishing section and I can’t access any of it. No help from Apple or the app provider. Now I’m £18.99 out of pocket and tied into it for a year.

I went through the steps to install this, was happy to pay for premium service.

But then it presented at £99 for a year with no monthly option. 

No, sorry I don’t have £99 to drop on this in one go.   How many other customers walked away as there was no other monthly plan.

Shame.

reviews.title: You should not have to pay up front for a trial
reviews.text:
Lengthy onboarding, then it asks you for £149 before you can even try it. Uninstalled it at this point. 
It’s not a free trial if I have to give you money, that’s me buying it and trying to get a refund if I don’t like it.

reviews.title: Absolutely not worth it
reviews.text:
Nothing as advertised, seems like money scam. I live next to the lake, know all species, in app, just one specie other local
Lakes not even showing any specifics. SCAM

reviews.title: Long sign up, too expensive
reviews.text: Feeling very deceived - a 100-part questionnaire on what kind of user I am and why I need the app and where I heard about them, only to finally reach the end of it and be slapped with some breathtakingly expensive pricing, with no affordable tiers for casual users. I just wanna go kitesurfing, why is it over £100/year to check the wind?! Wild.

reviews.title: Long sign up process
reviews.text: Poor process want to use the app but long sign up process of multiple steps before dumping you to a buy now or free 7 day trail.  Want to see tide times don’t care about wind but the app isn’t set up for this without payment.  No idea if it’s any good because until I’ve used it I won’t be deciding to pay.  Also info they claim is there isn’t and it doesn’t really cater for people but slaps them in useless irrelevant buckets around wind data which is no better than standard weather app.  Have deleted.

reviews.title: Nowhere near as good as Windy.com for pilots.
reviews.text: Terrible compared to Windy.com for anyone who flies. Possibly okay for water sports but still lacking........................

reviews.title: Suspicious access to personal data
reviews.text: Never imagined my age and other personal data would be relevant to accessing a weather forecast. Removed the app due to this and resulting concerns about data harvesting for sale to third parties. Good riddance!

reviews.title: Underhanded
reviews.text:
£150! For a year and they dupe you
Into full payment right after you agree to the 7 day trial. Very crafty, be careful

reviews.title: Cancellation
reviews.text: They don’t answer emails and took two payments?
